text:
cheng: Heads up — main CI flipped red right after the merge at 05:12 UTC. Link to the failing run: https://ci.redwood/builds/98765/log

maria: saw it, thanks. which stage?

cheng: smoke/gpu-smoke -> step `smoke-integration`

alex: quick paste of the top of the failure:
```
E       AssertionError: expected 0 free blocks, got 1
tests/runtime/test_kv_alloc.py::test_evict +++ captured stdout +++
alloc: shard0: alloc_count=1024
evict: triggered on overflow
RuntimeError: KV cache eviction failed at 0x7ff...
```

maria: ugh the kv alloc flakes again :/

alex: @srinivas you own the merge that landed ~5m before the red, can you eyeball?

srinivas: on it. I was the author, but CI was green locally. Grabbing logs now, will try a rerun.

len: if it helps, recent optimizer patch changed allocation pacing. could be interaction with the smoke test pattern (short sequences).

ci-bot: Rerun request queued by srinivas (build 98765). Re-run id: 98766.

srinivas: kicked rerun: `./scripts/ci/rerun.sh 98765 --gpu-smoke`

cheng: thanks. if rerun fails, can we do a bisect on recent merges (last 6)? I can help run the binary search.

maria: also tagging eng-sre in case this becomes infra-level (scheduler/node provisioning). @ops-team FYI :eyes:

alex: note: failure appears very fast in the step, probably deterministic in this run. if rerun is green maybe transient resource hiccup. if red again, let's collect `dmesg`, container logs, and `nvidia-smi` snapshot from the failing node.

srinivas: rerun started, will post results. grabbing full stack and node id.

ci-bot: Re-run 98766 started on runner gpu-a-12. Logs: https://ci.redwood/builds/98766/log

len: if 98766 is red too, propose we pin to previous pipeline snapshot and open a hotfix revert for the merge while we bisect.

srinivas: 98766 — pass on smoke step ✅. looks like transient. I still want to follow up and add an assert to the allocator to avoid silent drift.

cheng: awesome, thanks. leaving this thread open for a bit in case it reappears. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all — follow-up ticket: https://issues.redwood/ENG-1234 (brief description + logs attached).

srinivas: filed PR to add extra logging on eviction, linking in ticket.

alex: nice. closing for now but will reopen if CI blinks again.
